messages:
Maya Chen: quick heads-up — saw token-latency spike that correlates with cross-region failovers after the runtime change yesterday. Need a low-overhead telemetry plan: token-level latency breakdowns, per-route KPIs, kv cache hit/miss tagging, kernel and batch_size labels, and a routing-decision trace for a sample of requests. who can own?

Liam Patel: I can take the prom exporter side. initial observation: p95 for token-to-token jumps up ~30ms when kv_hit=false and route falls back to us-west. i'll attach raw prom example below for convo.

Liam Patel: ```
# example prom line (sketch)
redwood_runtime_token_latency_ms_bucket{route="/chat/completions",model_variant="rwkv-6b-v1",kernel="cutlass_v2",batch_size="4",kv_hit="false",from_region="eu-west-1",to_region="us-west-2",fallback_reason="capacity"} 42
```

Priya Singh: +1 on low-overhead sampling. proposal: emit compact histograms for every request with only a few high-cardinality labels (route, region, kv_hit) and do a sampled detailed event 1/1000 that includes full labels (kernel, batch_size, model_variant, route_policy, trace_id). This lets dashboards show accurate aggregates and still support debug.

Jon Reyes: dashboard needs: 1) token-latency split by kv_hit (hit vs miss) 2) per-route request rate & error/fallback rates 3) routing policy effectiveness (percent routed to preferred-region vs fallback) 4) cross-region tail latency heatmap. also add alert: cross-region-failover-rate > 0.5% over 5m.

Sofia Martinez: watch ingestion cost — token-level histograms explode cardinality. instead of full tagset per-tick, propose these rollups:
- minute-level counters by (route, region, kv_hit)
- top-50 routes keep full detail, rest collapse to route="other"
- sampled event stream for flamegraph/traces
This reduces Datadog/Prom cardinality while keeping debugging signals.

deploy-bot: ALERT: cross-region-failover-rate exceeded threshold in eu-west-1 -> us-west-2 (0.87%) at 2026-06-12T15:03:21Z :rotating_light:

Maya Chen: thanks. we also saw a perf regression tied to commit `abc1234` where batching heuristic changed (we moved to eager-slice to reduce latency but increased cache churn). need a quick repro and metric to correlate: `batch_merges_per_minute`, `kv_eviction_rate`, `kv_miss_ratio`.

Liam Patel: will add metrics: `redwood_batching_merge_count` (by kernel,batch_size,route) and `redwood_kv_eviction_total` (by region,shard). also will label `routing_decision` with values {preferred, fallback, failover}.

Priya Singh: example prom queries for dashboards: 
```
# per-route kv miss rate
sum(rate(redwood_kv_requests_total{kv_hit="false"}[5m])) by (route,region) / sum(rate(redwood_kv_requests_total[5m])) by (route,region)

# token-level p95 where kv miss
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_token_latency_ms_bucket{kv_hit="false"}[5m])) by (le, route, region))
```

Jon Reyes: also add a metric for routing fallback reason distribution: `routing_fallback_count{from_region,to_region,reason}`. that helps us figure out capacity vs policy problems.

Sofia Martinez: once metrics are in, i'll run a cost estimate against our ingestion budget and propose rollbacks for high-cardinality labels if needed.

Maya Chen: owners: Liam = exporter + infra metrics, Priya = sampling + dashboard panels, Jon = alerts & SLO updates, Sofia = ingestion/cost audit. timeline: quick patch for exporter by EOD tomorrow, dashboards next day, canary monitoring for 48h. i'll kick off a 15m sync after exporter PR.

Liam Patel: noted. starting PR draft — will include a toggle `telemetry.full_labels_sampling_rate` default 0.001 and an ingest-safe histogram path for `token_latency_ms`.

Priya Singh: when you add the toggle please document default behavior in `docs/telemetry.md` and include the example prom queries above.

Maya Chen: adding meeting invite — 15m follow-up in #eng-runtime. please post links to PR + dashboard in this thread. thanks :mag_right:
